name: dev-memory-lifecycle-gates
title: Make dev-memory preflight mandatory before DEV and finish-decision mandatory before DONE, plus an advisory capture reminder on finding_resolve
description: Proofbound's own dev-memory system (.lattice/dev-memory/experience.jsonl, git-tracked, shared across all agents/sessions on this repo) is entirely voluntary today: dev_memory_preflight/dev_memory_start/dev_memory_capture/dev_memory_finish/dev_memory_finish_decision are never called automatically by any lifecycle handler, and canFinishGuard (the DONE gate) never checks for dev-memory activity. A story can reach DONE having captured zero lessons and nothing notices. This story closes that gap at three points: (1) an INIT_CHECK-phase gate requiring a recorded dev_memory_preflight acknowledgement before a story may enter DEV, so every session starts having actually consulted prior lessons; (2) a non-blocking advisory reminder appended to finding_resolve's own output, prompting in-the-moment capture rather than end-of-story recall; (3) a DONE-gate requirement that dev_memory_finish_decision has been recorded (captured | no-reusable-lesson | defer-with-reason -- an honest 'nothing to capture' is an acceptable, non-blocking answer, but silent skip is not).
